# NEW 2026-11-18 theme region stories (one local story per historical region, namespace oe_trs). Generated by gen_theme_region_stories.py; edit the generator, not this file.

# BYZ scope, monthly. Shares the story pack's spacing: nothing while BYZ has oe_ts_cd; then 10% a month.
oe_trs_monthly = {
    if = {
        limit = { NOT = { has_variable = oe_ts_cd } oe_story_gap_open = yes any_subject = { oe_trs_can_pick = yes } }
        random = {
            chance = 10
            random_subject = { limit = { oe_trs_can_pick = yes } save_scope_as = oe_trs_pick }
            if = { limit = { exists = scope:oe_trs_pick } oe_trs_dispatch = yes }
        }
    }
}

# BYZ scope; scope:oe_trs_pick is the theme. Cooldowns exactly as oe_ts_dispatch, then one of its eligible region stories.
oe_trs_dispatch = {
    if = { limit = { NOT = { has_variable = oe_dbg_n_trs } } set_variable = { name = oe_dbg_n_trs value = 0 } } change_variable = { name = oe_dbg_n_trs add = 1 }  # third round T3: event count
    set_variable = { name = oe_ts_cd months = 4 }
    oe_story_gap_set = yes
    set_variable = { name = oe_trs_theme value = scope:oe_trs_pick }
    scope:oe_trs_pick = { set_variable = { name = oe_ts_theme_cd years = 3 } }
    random_list = {
        10 = { trigger = { scope:oe_trs_pick = { oe_trs_ok_1 = yes } } set_variable = { name = oe_trs_done_1 years = 20 } trigger_event_non_silently = oe_trs.1 }
        10 = { trigger = { scope:oe_trs_pick = { oe_trs_ok_2 = yes } } scope:oe_trs_pick = { set_variable = { name = oe_trs_done_2 years = 20 } } trigger_event_non_silently = oe_trs.2 }
        10 = { trigger = { scope:oe_trs_pick = { oe_trs_ok_3 = yes } } scope:oe_trs_pick = { set_variable = { name = oe_trs_done_3 years = 20 } } trigger_event_non_silently = oe_trs.3 }

        10 = { trigger = { scope:oe_trs_pick = { oe_trs_ok_5 = yes } } scope:oe_trs_pick = { set_variable = { name = oe_trs_done_5 years = 20 } } trigger_event_non_silently = oe_trs.5 }
        10 = { trigger = { scope:oe_trs_pick = { oe_trs_ok_6 = yes } } scope:oe_trs_pick = { set_variable = { name = oe_trs_done_6 years = 20 } } trigger_event_non_silently = oe_trs.6 }

# ---- test helpers (no cooldown, done flag or condition is checked or set) ----
# BYZ scope. Tell region story $n$ on scope:oe_trs_pick.
oe_trs_fire_for = {
    set_variable = { name = oe_trs_theme value = scope:oe_trs_pick }
    trigger_event_non_silently = oe_trs.$n$
}
# Console (as Byzantium): effect oe_trs_fire = { n = 13 }
# Uses the theme of region $n$ if there is one, otherwise any theme with a ruler.
oe_trs_fire = {
    random_subject = { limit = { oe_theme_member_trigger = yes has_ruler = yes var:oe_theme_region_id ?= $n$ } save_scope_as = oe_trs_pick }
    if = {
        limit = { NOT = { exists = scope:oe_trs_pick } }
        random_subject = { limit = { oe_theme_member_trigger = yes has_ruler = yes } save_scope_as = oe_trs_pick }
    }
    if = { limit = { exists = scope:oe_trs_pick } oe_trs_fire_for = { n = $n$ } }
}
# Console (as Byzantium): effect oe_trs_fire_tag = { n = 13 tag = BYT01 }   (story $n$ on the theme with tag $tag$)
oe_trs_fire_tag = {
    c:$tag$ ?= { save_scope_as = oe_trs_pick }
    if = { limit = { exists = scope:oe_trs_pick } oe_trs_fire_for = { n = $n$ } }
}
# BYZ scope. Tell scope:oe_trs_pick its own region's story (region 1 is reached only through oe_trs_fire).
oe_trs_fire_own = {
    set_variable = { name = oe_trs_theme value = scope:oe_trs_pick }
    if = { limit = { scope:oe_trs_pick = { var:oe_theme_region_id ?= 2 } } trigger_event_non_silently = oe_trs.2 }

# BYZ scope. Run the scheduler now, as if the 10% roll had succeeded (clears oe_ts_cd first).
oe_trs_pulse_now = {
    remove_variable = oe_ts_cd
    oe_story_gap_clear = yes
    random_subject = { limit = { oe_trs_can_pick = yes } save_scope_as = oe_trs_pick }
    if = { limit = { exists = scope:oe_trs_pick } oe_trs_dispatch = yes }
}
# BYZ scope. Clear every region-story done flag and every theme story cooldown (oe_ts_cd, oe_ts_theme_cd).
oe_trs_reset = {
    remove_variable = oe_ts_cd
    oe_story_gap_clear = yes
    remove_variable = oe_trs_done_1
    every_subject = {
        limit = { oe_theme_member_trigger = yes }
        remove_variable = oe_ts_theme_cd
        remove_variable = oe_trs_done_2
        remove_variable = oe_trs_done_3
        remove_variable = oe_trs_done_4
        remove_variable = oe_trs_done_5
        remove_variable = oe_trs_done_6
        remove_variable = oe_trs_done_7
        remove_variable = oe_trs_done_9
        remove_variable = oe_trs_done_10
        remove_variable = oe_trs_done_11
        remove_variable = oe_trs_done_12
        remove_variable = oe_trs_done_13
        remove_variable = oe_trs_done_15
        remove_variable = oe_trs_done_16
        remove_variable = oe_trs_done_17
        remove_variable = oe_trs_done_18
        remove_variable = oe_trs_done_19
        remove_variable = oe_trs_done_22
        remove_variable = oe_trs_done_23
        remove_variable = oe_trs_done_24
        remove_variable = oe_trs_done_25
        remove_variable = oe_trs_done_26
        remove_variable = oe_trs_done_27
        remove_variable = oe_trs_done_29
        remove_variable = oe_trs_done_30
        remove_variable = oe_trs_done_31
        remove_variable = oe_trs_done_32
        remove_variable = oe_trs_done_33
        remove_variable = oe_trs_done_34
        remove_variable = oe_trs_done_35
        remove_variable = oe_trs_done_36
        remove_variable = oe_trs_done_37
        remove_variable = oe_trs_done_38
    }
}
